services.heading: How admissions are won
services.sub: Enquiries qualified instantly, so hot leads gets locked in.
services.step1Desc: Our specially designed and tested form surfaces what matters most to each parent, and we extract any shortlist or research they've already done to feed directly into how they're scored.
services.step2Desc: A profile is built from their answers and research, then scored 0-100 in real time and sorted into Hot (70-100), Warm (40-69), or Cold (0-39).
services.step3Desc: Hot leads book straight onto your calendar, and every lead is prioritised hot to cold, so you and your team know exactly who to follow up with first each day, helping you win more admissions.
services.step4Desc: Every follow-up is logged as an opportunity in our CRM dashboard, so you always know where each family stands and nothing slips through the cracks.
